statement: The Entity decides on the chain's own word, read at its own view. When it accepts a lock (a peer's frame, its own command, or a queued tx judged again when its Account proposes), forwards one, or co-signs an expiry, the Host has read `DeltaTransformer.hashToTimestamp(hashlock)` at the J block of the frame's view, and the Entity compares it with the second the lock's body signs (`terms.secondsOf(deadline)`) exactly as DeltaTransformer.sol 289-299 does: paid iff the value is not 0 and not after that second. Never heights. A paid hashlock refuses a lock for good (`paid_on_chain`: nothing can unpay it) and refuses an expiry for good (`revealed_on_chain`: the payee's way is a dispute), and a forward of it is given up with the inbound lock cancelled. A reading is the frame's own: a reading of another block is no reading (a secret shown between the two would be missed). A hashlock with no reading at the view is not decided: the lock or expiry is refused with `registry_unknown`, which can pass, the proposer takes the frame back, and the Account's other frames go on. A read the node fails, or one the node no longer serves, is no reading and a `registry_unread` notice told once for each hashlock and reason; it is a fault for that decision only, never the Account's other frames and never a halt. The Host reads only what the frame may decide on (`wantsOf`: locks, expiries and forwards in its inputs, queued txs, forwards that wait), at the view the frame begins at (a waiting height frame, at that height, for every hosted Entity); readings travel on the Runtime input, so the WAL row holds them and a replay decides what the first run did. A node that may hold value is refused unless its setup decides on the registry (`registry_off`), and a setup that does without a port to read it is refused (`no_registry`). The watcher's `shown` stays as the fast path, and an entry is dropped once nothing names its hashlock. The comparison is pinned by the real DeltaTransformer in BrowserVM at the exact second, one past, and before the lock existed.
source: coordinator ruling 10-03 04:11 (registry read at the view, late lock, slack); DeltaTransformer.sol applyPayment and revealSecret; R-REVEAL-BACKSTOP owed rows (slack, late lock); builder
